scope: Prepared first-peer preauth retry identity capture
implementation: Only a live pending first-peer scope can publish preauth identity during detach.
Identity contains original request serial and exact BSS/MAC/BSSID/WCID/generation; adapter-owned value record survives response finish.
Capture requires current SST_NOT_AUTH plus visible/table generation, exact interface/MAC, idle close owner and no current event lease. Generic inactive entries without provenance refuse.

Callback-side helper compares original captured serial/generation/MAC/BSSID/BSS with current provenance before acquiring one transaction/event_users lease and adopting a pending-peer scope; no MAC-only recapture.

checks.coverage: GNU11 O2 Werror ASan/UBSan; pending vs existing origin; retained identity after detached response finish; missing provenance/wrong BSS/stale generation/output alias refusal. Retry lease: original identity accepted, changed serial/generation/BSSID/MAC/BSS and changed current publication refused; double enter refuses and standard pending leave balances ownership.

limits: Native RX queue stamping and callback invocation remain unimplemented; independent callback-side retry lease helper is host verified.
Delete/generation retirement and successful AUTH clearing of provenance still require integration.
Native token/event/completion/cache transaction not connected. Prepared composers remain uninstalled; no target/image/device verification.
